destinations.name: Delhi
destinations.tagline: Mughal monuments, bazaars and legendary street food
destinations.description: India's capital and the natural gateway for most tours: Old Delhi lanes, Lutyens' boulevards and some of the best food in the country.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.tagline: The Taj Mahal and Mughal grandeur
destinations.description: Home of the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort and Mehtab Bagh. Best seen at sunrise, before the crowds.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.tagline: The Pink City of forts, bazaars and block prints
destinations.description: Amber Fort, City Palace and bustling bazaars, plus hands-on crafts and one of India's best food scenes.

destinations.name: Ranthambore
destinations.tagline: Tiger safaris in a thousand-year-old fort forest
destinations.description: One of India's best chances to see a wild tiger, with a hilltop fort inside the national park.

destinations.name: Pushkar
destinations.tagline: Sacred lake, ghats and a laid-back cafe culture
destinations.description: A small holy town around a lake with 52 ghats, a rare Brahma temple and a relaxed backpacker bazaar.

destinations.name: Jodhpur
destinations.tagline: The Blue City beneath mighty Mehrangarh
destinations.description: Blue-washed lanes below one of India's most impressive forts, with ziplines, village safaris and spicy mirchi vadas.

destinations.name: Jaisalmer
destinations.tagline: A living golden fort on the edge of the Thar
destinations.description: Sandstone havelis, camel safaris in the Sam dunes and folk music nights under desert skies.

destinations.name: Udaipur
destinations.tagline: The City of Lakes: palaces, boats and sunsets
destinations.description: Romantic lake palaces, rooftop sunsets, cooking classes and folk dance evenings.

destinations.name: Bikaner
destinations.tagline: Camel country, Junagarh Fort and the famous bhujia
destinations.description: A desert trading town with a never-conquered fort, carved sandstone havelis and India's camel research farm.

destinations.name: Chittorgarh
destinations.tagline: India's largest fort and the legend of Rani Padmini
destinations.description: A hilltop fort that runs for 13 km, with victory towers, palaces and reservoirs built over eight centuries.

destinations.name: Mount Abu
destinations.tagline: Rajasthan's only hill station, lakes and Dilwara marble
destinations.description: Cool forest air, Nakki Lake and the most intricate marble temples in India.

destinations.name: Bundi
destinations.tagline: Stepwells, murals and the fort Kipling loved
destinations.description: A small blue town under Taragarh Fort, full of stepwells and some of Rajasthan's finest palace murals.

activities.title: Amber Fort Guided Heritage Walk

activities.title: City Palace & Jantar Mantar Tour

activities.title: Old City Street Food Trail
activities.description: Pyaaz kachori, ghewar, lassi in clay cups and a thali to finish, with the stories behind each stall.

activities.title: Sanganer Block-Printing Workshop
activities.description: Carve, ink and print your own scarf with a third-generation block-printing family.

activities.title: Nahargarh Sunset & Stepwell

activities.title: Johari & Bapu Bazaar Shopping Walk

activities.title: Mehrangarh Flying Fox Zipline

activities.title: Blue City Photo Walk

activities.title: Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum

activities.title: Sardar Market Food Crawl
